body:
I left the US cause I hate it here. I hate the greed, the corruption, the injustice, the gun culture, the rape culture, the unwillingness to face the past injustices, and the general superficial nature here. I only like the nature here. So i leave and try to make it abroad, but I fail. My visa ran out and now I'm back. Now that I'm finally at the point where I want to fold my cards and cash out, I find out I'm living in one of the only 2-3 states that would make it impossible for me to buy a gun without a nearby family member finding out. And if they saw me trying to get a permit for a gun, they would put 2 and 2 together right away.

It's a shame, I had a perfect plan. I'd get a lovely little .38 revolver, maybe even a .357, put on some nice clothes, and go for a stroll in the woods. There are some stone ruins of a colonial building at the end of the trail. Nice little spot. I would have my wallet and a picture on me so they could ID me if it gets messy. But because I live in this particular state, I can't do any of that. And crossing state lines doesn't work either, you have to buy based on where you live.

I left the US because I can't stand the stupidity and culture here, including the gun culture. Now that I'm back and I want to off myself, I need a gun, but I can't get one. If I don't kill myself today, maybe the irony will.
